verdict.rationale: Supabase is built on standard Postgres and is open-source, and documents self-hosting for full control of data (supabase-docs-3, supabase-docs-29, supabase-docs-32), which implies data portability via standard Postgres tooling (e.g., pg_dump, referenced indirectly in supabase-comm-5). However, there is no explicit first-party documentation of a dedicated 'export all your data' or account-closure/data-portability workflow beyond the underlying Postgres/self-hosting architecture.  missing for 10: explicit data-export/portability docs, GDPR-style account data takeout feature, independent confirmation that self-hosted migration is smooth in practice.
